progress.link:
Press the Auth or Service button on your PoolSync device at {ip_address} to complete local linking.

The integration is waiting for the device to return its access password. This attempt will time out after about {time_remaining} seconds.

user.title: PoolSync Setup: Connect to Device
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your AutoPilot PoolSync device.

reauth_confirm.title: PoolSync Reauthenticate Device
reauth_confirm.description: Press Submit to start local relinking for the PoolSync device at {ip_address}. Then press the Auth or Service button on the physical device to complete reauthentication.

reconfigure.title: PoolSync Reconfigure Device
reconfigure.description: Enter the new local IP address of your AutoPilot PoolSync device. The current address is {ip_address}.

link_failed.title: PoolSync Setup: Link Device
link_failed.description:
The PoolSync device at {ip_address} did not finish linking. Select Submit to retry the push-link process.

If this keeps failing, restart the PoolSync device and try again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the PoolSync device at the specified IP address. Please check the IP address and ensure the device is powered on and connected to the network.
error.invalid_ip: The IP address format is invalid. Please enter a valid IP address (e.g., 192.168.1.100).
error.api_error: An API error occurred while communicating with the PoolSync device. Check Home Assistant logs for more details. The device might have responded with an unexpected message.
error.internal_error_polling_setup: Internal setup error during the device linking phase. Please try again.
error.link_failed: The linking process failed. The device did not provide a valid password after the button press, or a communication error occurred during linking. Please try again. You may need to restart your PoolSync device.
error.link_timeout: The linking process timed out. The Auth or Service button was not pressed within the allowed time, or the device did not respond with a password. Please try again. You may need to restart your PoolSync device.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This PoolSync device (based on its MAC address) is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: The device returned by the reauthentication flow does not match the already configured PoolSync device.
abort.internal_error: An internal error occurred in the configuration flow. Please try again.

init.title: PoolSync Options
init.description: Adjust settings for the PoolSync integration. The current update interval is {current_interval} seconds.

error.invalid_scan_interval: The scan interval must be a number greater than or equal to 10 seconds (e.g., 30, 60, 120).

set_group_state.name: Set group state
set_group_state.description: Turn a PoolSync group on or off, optionally with a custom duration.

group.name: Group
group.description: The group to control. Accepts the group name (e.g. "POOL", "WATERFALL") or its numeric key.

state.name: State
state.description: Whether to turn the group on or off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the group should run when turning it on. Accepts minutes (e.g. 90) or a human-readable value (e.g. "1d 10h 22m"). Only used when turning the group on.

set_pump_mode.name: Set pump mode
set_pump_mode.description: Set the circulation pump operating mode to auto, manual, or off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The pump operating mode to set.

rpm.name: RPM
rpm.description: The pump speed in RPM. Required when mode is "manual".

password_not_available.message: API password not available to set value.

heat_pump_target_not_available.message: PoolSync heat pump target is not available

heat_pump_mode_not_available.message: PoolSync heat pump mode is not available

pump_target_not_available.message: Pump write target is not available

rpm_required_manual.message: RPM is required when mode is manual

group_target_not_available.message: PoolSync group target is not available

runtime_data_not_available.message: PoolSync runtime data is not available

entity_not_added.message: Entity is not added to Home Assistant

preset_mode_unknown.message: Cannot set preset mode while heat pump mode is unknown

invalid_duration.message: Invalid duration: {duration}. Use minutes or a human-readable value like '1d 10h 22m'.

authentication_failed.title: PoolSync authentication failed
authentication_failed.description: The PoolSync device at {ip_address} rejected the stored password. Reauthenticate the integration to restore access.
